description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseDumper' used for profiling data visualization in Twig. It provides a structure for dumping profiling information with methods to format templates, non-templates, and timing details. The class interacts with the 'Profile' class to process profiling data, especially for hierarchical representations of profiled code segments.

classes.name: BaseDumper
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for dumping profiling data in a formatted manner for Twig's profiling system.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Public method to initiate the dump process for a given Profile object.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method for formatting a template profile segment.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Abstract method for formatting a non-template profile segment.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Abstract method for formatting timing information of a profile segment.

methods.name: dumpProfile
methods.description: Private recursive method to process and format the profiling hierarchy.
